edges.reason: msg.sender is used for the contract check, one-card-per-address check and as the mint recipient
The minted token is assigned to msg.sender via _safeMint
mint returns the excess ETH to the caller with transfer() after state updates
The refund receiver is derived from msg.sender and can be a contract
mint calls _random for VIP status, ePower, vPower, refBonus, discount and xFactor
block.timestamp is a seed component of the pseudo random generator, creating timestamp dependency
Weak random results steer the economic attributes of the newly minted card
mint writes the new User struct into userData
mint reads settings for caps, referral thresholds and bonus percentages
mint obtains the price through _price which reads cardPrices
mint increases userPool totalDeposited, accTokenPerShare and totalAmountDistributed
mint increases vipPool totalDeposited, accTokenPerShare and totalAmountDistributed
mint adds level1 and level2 referral bonuses to directRefBonusBalance
mint adds the residual amount to commissionPoolBalance
mint promotes a parent reaching the referral threshold into the VIP pool
The parent token id parameter drives discount, referral and VIP promotion logic
The wannaVIP parameter selects the price and the destination pool
The computed requiredValue is used for the msg.value payment check
mint computes requiredValue from the card price and the 10% parent discount
mintedTokenID is derived from totalSupply() inside mint
claimReward resolves the caller's token through tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender,0)
directRefBonusPayout is computed from userData inside claimReward
poolRewardPayout is computed from pendingReward inside claimReward
claimReward transfers the accumulated ETH to the caller with transfer() after bookkeeping
claimReward updates pendingReward, rewardDebt, totalRewarded and withdrawn balances in userData
claimReward debits directRefBonusBalance by the referral payout
claimReward debits userPool.totalAmountDistributed for non VIP users
claimReward debits vipPool.totalAmountDistributed for VIP users
claimCommissionPool compares msg.sender with the stored distributor address
commissionPoolDistributor is the privileged caller of claimCommissionPool
The commission pool is paid with a low-level call forwarding all gas
The call target is taken from commissionPoolDistributor, which may be a malicious contract
claimCommissionPool reads and zeroes commissionPoolBalance before the call
acceptPartnerFee credits the value received to msg.sender
acceptPartnerFee increases undistributedServiceContractsBalance[msg.sender]
distributePartnerFee reads and clears the partner balance entry
distributePartnerFee reads the whitelisted referrer tokenID for the partner
distributePartnerFee forwards the collected amount to _distributeServiceFee
Service fees are credited to directRefBonusBalance including level2 bonuses
The commission share of service fees is added to commissionPoolBalance
The residual service fee is added to userPool accounting
The VIP pool commission is added to vipPool accounting
buyService distributes the collected fee through _distributeServiceFee
buyService refunds the excess ETH to the caller with transfer()
buyService rewards the parent with additional earning power
_increaseEPower settles pendingReward and updates ePower and rewardDebt in userData
_increaseEPower increases userPool.totalDeposited when the user is not VIP
_increaseEPower increases vipPool.totalDeposited when the user is VIP
upgradeToVIP delegates the upgrade to upgradeTokenToVIP with the caller's token
upgradeToVIP resolves the caller's token through tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender,0)
upgradeTokenToVIP moves the token into the VIP pool
upgradeTokenToVIP refunds the excess ETH to msg.sender with transfer()
upgradeTokenToVIP updates vPower, refBonus and discount in userData
upgradeTokenToVIP raises totalVPower by the voting power difference
upgradeTokenToVIP credits the VIP pool with the upgrade commission
upgradeTokenToVIP credits the commission pool with the residual amount
upgradeTokenToVIP credits directRefBonusBalance with referral bonuses
The token id parameter selects which user record is upgraded
_moveUserToVIPPool migrates ePower, rewardDebt, pendingReward and vip flag in userData
_moveUserToVIPPool removes the ePower from userPool.totalDeposited
_moveUserToVIPPool adds the ePower to vipPool.totalDeposited
_moveUserToVIPPool moves settled pending rewards into directRefBonusBalance
_moveUserToVIPPool increments totalVIPs
_price reads the base prices from cardPrices
_price adds a surcharge proportional to totalVIPs for VIP cards
burn executes the destructive operation without any ownership or approval verification
Any msg.sender can destroy an arbitrary token id through burn
The burn entry point is callable by any external account
setUserImage writes the imageHash field of the caller's userData entry
The image hash parameter is stored in the user record
setUserImage resolves the caller's token through tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender,0)
The onlyOwner updateSettings function writes arbitrary entries of the settings array
The onlyOwner whitelistServiceContract function writes the whitelist mapping
The onlyOwner setServicePrice function writes servicePrices
Any caller can trigger distributePartnerFee for a partner address
The partner address parameter selects the balance and whitelist entry to process
The service id parameter indexes servicePrices to obtain the required value
_random derives its base hash from block values and the caller supplied seed
block.timestamp feeds the randomness base, making the outcome timestamp dependent
The derived base determines the returned pseudo random value
thisRefBonus accumulates level1 and level2 referral bonuses during mint
thisVipPoolBonus is computed from the payment and the VIP pool percentage
userVip decides pool membership, price share and card attributes
userEPower is deposited into the selected pool and stored in the user record
claimReward reads accTokenPerShare from the pool matching the user's VIP status

normalization_plan.reason: The parent token id parameter only feeds mint's discount, referral and VIP promotion logic
The VIP flag parameter only selects the price and pool inside mint
The token id parameter is only consumed by upgradeTokenToVIP
The service id parameter is only used to index servicePrices in buyService
The partner address parameter is only used to pick the balance and whitelist entry
The image hash parameter is only stored by setUserImage
requiredValue is a temporary amount computed and compared inside mint
mintedTokenID is a temporary token id derived from totalSupply() during mint
thisRefBonus is a temporary accumulator of referral payouts within mint
thisVipPoolBonus is a temporary share value computed inside mint
userVip is a temporary boolean resolved inside mint
userEPower is the temporary earning power assigned during mint
accTokenPerShare is a temporary pool snapshot read during claimReward
directRefBonusPayout is the referral amount transferred out by the payout operation
poolRewardPayout is the pool amount transferred out by the payout operation
randomBase is the block derived pseudo random seed used by the weak randomness operation
